summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology (Nasdaq: RYET), a China-based AI education firm, disclosed via Form 6-K that it received a Nasdaq notice dated October 7, 2026, stating its ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (August 25-October 6, 2026), failing Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has 180 calendar days, until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance by holding a $1.00 close for ten consecutive business days, subject to Nasdaq discretion. No immediate trading effect. Watch reverse-split or price-recovery actions and potential overhang from a compliance-forced capital structure change.
